avg_distance_by_vehicle.png.insight: SUV/Prime variants show the longest average trip distances; Auto/Bike serve shorter hops.

booking_status_distribution.png.insight: About ~60–65% of bookings complete successfully; driver cancels exceed customer cancels.

boxplot_booking_value.png.insight: Booking value is right-skewed—most rides are low to mid value; a few long trips drive the tail.

boxplot_ride_distance.png.insight: Typical rides sit in a compact range; outliers indicate occasional very long trips.

cancellations_by_hour.png.insight: Cancellations spike around commute peaks (8–10 AM, 6–8 PM), suggesting demand/supply frictions.

cancellations_by_payment.png.insight: Cash/UPI dominate cancellations simply due to higher usage; no strong payment-specific risk observed.

cancellations_by_vehicle.png.insight: Bike shows a slightly higher cancel share; sedans are steadier across time.

correlation_heatmap.png.insight: Booking_Value correlates with Ride_Distance and duration; ratings show weak correlation to value/time.

customer_ratings_distribution.png.insight: Customer ratings cluster tightly around 4.0—service quality appears consistent.

customer_segmentation.png.insight: A small segment contributes disproportionately to value—good targets for loyalty perks.

daily_ride_volume.png.insight: Daily volume fluctuates with mild mid-month upticks; weekend dips reflect commute-driven demand.

driver_ratings_distribution.png.insight: Driver ratings mirror customer ratings (3.8–4.2 core band) with few extremes.

incomplete_reasons.png.insight: Operational issues (e.g., AC not working, address issues) lead most incomplete cases.

incomplete_rides.png.insight: Incomplete rides are a small fraction but worth targeting in hotspots to reduce leakage.

revenue_by_payment_method.png.insight: Cash and UPI contribute ~90% of revenue; card payments are small but stable.

ride_duration_boxplot.png.insight: Most rides finish within a compact duration band; tail events drive peaks in value and distance.

ride_duration_zoomed.png.insight: Zoom clarifies the central mass of ride times—useful for SLA and ETA setting.

rides_by_dayofweek.png.insight: Weekday rides > weekend rides, reinforcing commute-heavy usage.

rides_by_hour.png.insight: Two clear peaks (AM/PM commutes); late night demand is minimal.

top_customers.png.insight: Top customers book far more frequently—opportunity for subscription or rewards.

top_customers_value.png.insight: Top 10 customers contribute a sizable share of total value—prioritize retention.

weekly_trend.png.insight: Weekly seasonality is visible: early-week ramps, weekend softening.
